title: Fibrinolysis Compared to Thoracoscopy for Pleural Infection
brief_summary: The purpose of this prospective randomized clinical trial is to compare two currently accepted standard-of-care treatment strategies: Medical thoracoscopy as compared to instillation of intrapleural tissue Plasminogen Activator (TPA) and human recombinant Deoxyribonuclease (DNase) for the management of empyema or complicated parapneumonic effusion (CPPE) in adults.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Subjects \>18 years old with:

Evidence of empyema or complex parapneumonic effusion

Exclusion Criteria:

Age \<18 years Pregnancy Inability to give informed written consent Previous thoracic surgery or thrombolytic therapy for pleural infection Medical thoracoscopy cannot be performed within 48 hours Hemodynamic instability or severe hypoxemia Non corrected coagulopathy Homogeneously echogenic effusion on pleural ultrasonography
